initialization: all EEG encoder and image decoder learnable state starts from one fresh random B0 source at seed17; no trained model state
optimizer: new AdamW per arm; one group containing every trainable parameter
schedule: linear step1..190 inclusive, then cosine step191..2660 inclusive
loss: image latent MSE + 0.1 symmetric image contrastive
normalization: recomputed from all 2400 subject0 training trials only, per electrode and frequency bin
test_policy: predeclared historical exploratory test at epochs 0,10,20,30,40,50,60,70; no early stopping or checkpoint selection
